data.title: 八重神子 · 海滨祭典的油豆腐冰饮
data.description: 【稻妻海滨祭典·盛夏】八重神子穿着粉白泳装外搭轻薄祭典罩衫，坐在海边高台上摇着折扇，手边放着油豆腐风味冰饮；她看着远处烟火，狐耳随海风微动，转回镜头时笑得像早已猜到所有人的心思。
data.action: 海滨高台摇扇看烟火，狐耳随海风微动，回眸像早已看穿心思
data.lighting: deep summer dusk, lanterns and fireworks
data.mood: 宫司把度假也写成一场戏
data.promptProse: Yae Miko from Genshin Impact wears a pink-and-white resort swimsuit with a light festival robe, gold hair ornaments and a chilled tofu-flavored drink. She sits above the Inazuma shore with a folding fan in one hand and a chilled tofu-inspired drink in the other. Her fox ears twitch at the fireworks, and she turns back toward the viewer with a knowing smile as the sea breeze moves her pink hair. deep summer dusk, lanterns and fireworks.
